steps: Schema editor: add custom field Take, type Number, RIFF ID ITKN
Select a file that has no ITKN (comment-only.wav or a fresh copy of sample.wav), change Title or Category, Save Tags
Dump the raw LIST/INFO and run ffprobe -show_entries format_tags

bugs.actual: ITKN is written as '0' (size 1, hex 30); ffprobe shows ITKN=0 on comment-only.wav and cat-new.wav. The badge ignores 0, so the row is not marked Tagged.
